selection: Lowest process-group-weighted validation MAE. Prefer simpler model within 5 percent of minimum MAE.
margin: Nonnegative 99th percentile of calibration positive residuals. No held-out recalibration.
scope: Coverage target applies separately to quantum and full-next-completed-token targets. It is not a hard deadline guarantee.
coverage_CI: Bootstrap independent process-start groups, 2000 draws, seed 20261023. Do not treat quanta as independent samples.
online_gate: Both selected models require held-out coverage >=0.95 and query overhead <=200 us. Report prefill phase, shape, schema and OOD failures separately. Any unresolved candidate-specific DAG or queue cost remains a block on SLO guarantees.
failure_action: Keep offline diagnostic upper bounds. Do not tune features, margins, or thresholds after blind results.
